title: Maine Host List
description: Version 2 of the Maine saved-host list (version 1 files, which have no groups, remain valid). This is the portable configuration format that every Maine client (macOS today; Linux and Android in future) reads and writes. The file lives next to the client's own data, is never synced by Maine, and never contains passwords or private keys.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the configuration format: 1 or 2. Version 2 adds the optional top-level groups array and each host's optional group. Clients MUST refuse files with a higher version than they implement.

groups.description: Sidebar groups, in the order the user arranged them (version 2). A group may have no hosts. Whether a group is collapsed is per-device state and is not stored here.

hosts.description: The saved hosts, in the order the user arranged them. Clients MUST NOT limit the number of entries.

host.title: Host
host.description: A single saved SSH host. Every field is user-editable except id.

id.description: Stable, client-generated identifier. A lowercase UUID string is recommended. Clients MUST NOT derive meaning from it and MUST NOT change it when other fields are edited.

name.description: The label shown in the host list.

hostname.description: What is passed to OpenSSH as the connection target: an IP address, a DNS name, or a Host alias defined in the user's own ~/.ssh/config. No whitespace, no leading '-'.

port.description: TCP port to connect to. The value 22 means 'default'; clients SHOULD omit the ssh -p flag in that case so a matching ~/.ssh/config stanza can decide the real port.

username.description: Remote user name. The empty string means 'not specified'; clients SHOULD omit the ssh -l flag in that case so OpenSSH can take the user from ~/.ssh/config, the key, or the local user name.

group.description: Optional (version 2): the id of the group this host belongs to. Absent means ungrouped. A value that names no group in this file MUST be treated as ungrouped.

group.title: Group
group.description: A named section of the host list. Hosts refer to it by id.

id.description: Stable, client-generated identifier (UUID). Clients MUST NOT change it on rename.

name.description: The label shown on the group header.
